description: This file contains functions related to serialization and deserialization of an EWAH (Efficient Word-Aligned Hybrid) bitmap data structure, including reading from memory maps and writing to buffers, with platform-independent handling of binary data. It defines functions for serializing to a callback, serializing to a string buffer, and reading a bitmap from a memory mapping.

methods.name: int ewah_serialize_to(struct ewah_bitmap * self,int (* write_fun)(void *,const void *,size_t),void * data)
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap object by writing its size, buffer contents, and rlw position to a user-defined output function.

methods.name: int ewah_serialize_strbuf(struct ewah_bitmap * self,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap object into a string buffer.

methods.name: ssize_t ewah_read_mmap(struct ewah_bitmap * self,const void * map,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads an ewah_bitmap object from a memory-mapped buffer, reconstructing its internal state accordingly.

methods.name: int write_strbuf(void * user_data,const void * data,size_t len)

ctags.name: ewah_read_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t ewah_read_mmap(struct ewah_bitmap *self, const void *map, size_t len)$/
